appDescription.message: Explicitly connect this Chrome profile's bookmarks and normal tabs to your local Tuff app.

intro.message: Connect only this Chrome profile to Tuff on this computer.

pairHelp.message: In Tuff, open the avatar → Chrome connections, install the local bridge, then generate a pairing code. Enter that one-use code here.

privacy.message: Only bookmarks and normal-tab metadata are shared after pairing. No cookies, passwords, history, Google identity or incognito access. Tuff uses a separate website login session.

pauseHelp.message: Disconnect disables automatic connection without deleting Chrome data. Reconnect enables it again. If paused in Tuff, resume there first. To revoke the approved key permanently, disconnect this profile in Tuff.

connectionFailed.message: Cannot connect. Open Tuff, install its local bridge if needed, and reconnect.

invalidServerProof.message: The local endpoint's Tuff identity check failed. This connection was stopped; no further profile signatures or Chrome data will be shared. Reopen Tuff and reconnect.

snapshotReceiptsPending.message: Waiting for Tuff to accept earlier snapshots. The previous library is preserved; reconnect if this continues.

permissionsRequired.message: Bookmarks and tabs permission is required. Use Pair or Reconnect to grant it.

serverRejected.message: Tuff did not accept the connection. Check that it is not paused and use a fresh pairing code if this profile was disconnected.

invalidMessage.message: The connector received an invalid message. Reconnect after updating Tuff and this extension together.

invalidPairingCode.message: Enter a valid, unexpired pairing code from Tuff.

invalidProfileLabel.message: Enter a profile name of 1–100 characters.

snapshotTooLarge.message: This profile exceeds the snapshot size limit. The previous library is preserved; no partial library was published.

frameTooLarge.message: A message exceeds the transport limit. The previous library is preserved.

operationIdReused.message: A command ID was reused with different content. The command was not applied.

connectionChanged.message: The connection changed. Reconnect to refresh its state.

journalUnavailable.message: Chrome could not save the command journal. No new write can start safely.

bookmarkChanged.message: Chrome changed this bookmark or folder. Resolve the conflict in Tuff.

readOnlyBookmark.message: This bookmark or folder is managed or read-only.

unsafeUrl.message: New links must use HTTP or HTTPS without embedded credentials.

interruptedOperation.message: A command was interrupted; its result is uncertain. Review Chrome before resolving the conflict in Tuff.

snapshotFailed.message: Cannot read a complete snapshot. The previous library is preserved.
